name: Dual Sign Rank of Universal Class
proof: Dual sign rank is not sign rank of the transposed matrix. Proposition 1 of Alon--Moran--Yehudayoff gives \(\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)\leq\mathrm{DSR}(\mathcal H)\leq2\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)+1\). Since \(\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal U_n)=\lfloor\log_2n\rfloor\), substitution gives the displayed bounds.
